player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Connect Four.
Your disc symbol: {symbol}.
The game board has {num_rows} rows and {num_cols} columns.
Players take turns dropping their disc into one of the columns (0 to {end_col}).
The first to connect (their own) four discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally wins.
On your turn, enter the column number in squared brackets to make your move.
For example: '[col 4]' or '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: खिलाड़ी {player_id}, अमान्य क्रिया प्रारूप। अपेक्षित प्रारूप: '[col x]'।
invalid_move.out_of_range: खिलाड़ी {player_id}, अमान्य क्रिया। स्तंभ {col} सीमा से बाहर है।
invalid_move.already_full: खिलाड़ी {player_id}, अमान्य क्रिया। स्तंभ {col} भरा हुआ है।

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} dropped their disk ({player_symbol}) into column {col}.

outcome.win: {player_id} इति क्रीडाकारः चतुर्णां सङ्कलनं कृत्वा विजयी भवति!
